Just Outside Seaside in Old Seagrove. Walk to the Public Beach Access on Dogwood Street

Privacy, Luxury and Comfort Assured in this Home located in the Heart of Old Seagrove – Just Steps to the Beach, Seaside and Watercolor.
The beautifully detailed home is just a short walk to Seaside, dining, and neighborhood access to the public beach. The house is on one of the largest lots in Old Seagrove and was designed to assure resort like living. The house was built to be in scale with the historic beach cottage neighborhood, to add spacious living areas for entertaining and the most up to date finishes and top quality appliances.

The one level home features generous interiors and large porches on the front and back of the house. The lot is wooded and quiet. Enjoy the sights and sounds of nature throughout the day. The front porch has four comfortable Adirondeck chairs best suited for enjoying morning coffee or an evening’s glass of wine.

Enter the home in to the Great Room, clad in white shiplap, a soaring ceiling, windows and doors all of which allow you to feel as if the outside has come in! Comfortable seating for eight in the great room surrounds a 75” TV.

The dining table comfortably seats ten and is open to the gourmet kitchen. A large Island centers the kitchen. A sub zero refrigerator and Wolf stove will please the most avid chef. Carrera Marble counters throughout. The house offers all custom cabinetry stocked with everything you need to enjoy your beach vacation. Sub Zero Refrigerator, Six burner Wolf Gas range, fully equipped kitchen with All Clad cookware, ample glassware and service for up to twelve people, Keurig coffee maker and so much more.

The great room opens out on to an oversized screened porch. There is more comfortable seating and another dining area on the rear porch. The dining table can comfortably accommodate eight people.

The screen porch overlooks the patio and pool which can be heated for your enjoyment even during the cool weather. You will find it hard to leave this gracious back yard and pool. Lounge, dine and BBQ in the privacy of your own back yard. The outdoor shower, custom built, is private and yet open to nature. No detail has been omitted.

The Master Suite, with a King bed, has a soaring ceiling. There is a large TV in the master bedroom. The master bath, with an open, oversized walk in shower, is also luxurious. Twin sinks, a fully mirrored wall and designer quality lighting combine to add feeling of luxury in the space.

The second bedroom, also generously sized, has a King Bed and lovely furnishings. The third bedroom is the room the kids will fight over with four built in bunks.

The second full bath is as large and luxurious as the Master Bath.

There is also an office if you absolutely cannot escape the demands of work.

And while we love our dog, we understand that you, too, may not want to leave home without yours. We will consider a small (under 20 pounds, non shedding) dog. There is an additional fee for your pooch.

This house is for the discerning renter who wants to come to 30A and enjoy comfort and luxury amid the peace of Old Seagrove.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.text: Our recent stay at this vacation rental in Santa Rosa Beach was nothing short of exceptional, making it an ideal haven for multigenerational travel with kids and grandparents alike. The house’s thoughtful layout featured separate bedrooms thoughtfully positioned away from the kitchen, ensuring that any late-night meal prep or early morning coffee brewing didn’t disturb those catching some extra sleep. We loved the added perks like provided bikes for exploring the nearby trails and an array of beach accessories that made our seaside outings effortless and fun. The kitchen was fully equipped with high-quality appliances, ample cookware, and even those little extras like spices and gadgets that turned cooking at home into a delight rather than a chore. It had everything we needed and more, allowing us to enjoy family meals together. Overall, this spot was exceeding our expectations.
